solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: State time and month in which former rulers returned

indicators.note: returned means the whole assembled string is read backwards
in which says the rulers go inside the month

parts.note: AUG is the abbreviation for August
the Raj was British rule in India, now gone

explanation.surface: A historical note about a state where old rulers came back at a particular time and month.
explanation.walkthrough: The Raj is the period of British rule in India; 'returned' applies to the whole string, not just the rulers.
explanation.definitionFit: Gujarat is a state in western India.

clue.text: Ship in an American shade: green

indicators.note: in places the ship inside the colour word

parts.note: GRAY is the American spelling of grey
SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: Describing a vessel painted in an American colour, which turns out to be green.
explanation.definitionFit: Grassy ground is covered with grass, hence verdant.

clue.text: Remarkable value I judge in work often disowned

indicators.note: remarkable read as re-markable: marked out afresh, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: I as written, then J, the abbreviation for judge
taken as written

explanation.surface: A judge considers a work of notable value, the sort its author might rather forget.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link word but its letters are part of the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Juvenilia are an artist's youthful pieces, which mature writers often prefer to disown.

clue.text: Senior relations to have called round

indicators.note: round says the word for called goes around the relations

parts.note: rang means telephoned, called
kin are one's relatives

explanation.surface: An elderly person's relatives phoned around to see them.
explanation.definitionFit: A ranking officer is the senior one, highest in rank.

clue.text: Frightening pictures put up for all to see, one originally concealed under carpet

indicators.note: in a down clue, under places the following letters below the carpet word
in a down clue, put up means the word is written upwards, so reversed

parts.note: art means pictures
U is the British film certificate for universal viewing, suitable for all
a mat is a small carpet
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: originally means take the first letter of concealed

explanation.surface: Scary images get displayed publicly, while one was originally hidden under a rug.
explanation.walkthrough: U is the British film rating meaning suitable for everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Something traumatic is deeply distressing or shocking, as frightening experiences are.

clue.text: Groups of salmon right at mouth of stream

parts.note: the coho is a Pacific salmon

indicators.note: the mouth of a word is its opening letter, here of stream

explanation.surface: Shoals of salmon gathering right at a river mouth.
explanation.definitionFit: Cohorts are bands or companies of people, originally Roman army units.

clue.text: Inside-out cover on fish basket

indicators.note: with its inside out, only the outer letters of cover remain

parts.note: an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: A fish basket with a cover that has been turned inside out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fish basket' reads as one phrase, but the fish is EEL and basket alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A creel is a wicker basket used by anglers.

clue.text: Header against the post?

parts.note: sounds like a football header hitting the goalpost, but means a label attached to a social media post

explanation.walkthrough: The football picture misleads: the post is an online message and the header is the tag marked with the # symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: A tag prefixed with the # symbol labels a social media message by topic.

clue.text: Bird is yellow, except head

indicators.note: except head means the first letter is removed

parts.note: yellow means cowardly, craven

explanation.surface: A remark that a bird is yellow apart from its head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yellow' looks like a colour but means cowardly.
explanation.definitionFit: The raven is a large black crow.

clue.text: Song composed to capture a daughter

indicators.note: to capture means the calm word surrounds the other letters

parts.note: composed means calm, serene

explanation.surface: A song written to win over a girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composed' looks like writing music but means calm.
explanation.definitionFit: A serenade is a love song sung beneath a window.

clue.text: Commercial vehicle with identification at rear of offside edge

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
a van is a vehicle
a tag identifies something

indicators.note: rear of a word means its last letter, here of offside

explanation.surface: A sports-flavoured scene of an advertising van with an ID tag parked at the back near the offside.
explanation.definitionFit: An advantage is an edge, a superior position over a rival.

clue.text: Perhaps lifeguard's singular state

parts.note: S is the grammar abbreviation for singular
aver means to state firmly

explanation.surface: Remarking on a lifeguard's unique condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' looks like a noun but is the verb aver.
explanation.definitionFit: A lifeguard saves swimmers, so is one example of someone who rescues.

clue.text: Finally converted cheerful Muslim

indicators.note: finally converted means the last letter is changed to another

parts.note: sunny means cheerful

explanation.surface: A cheerful Muslim, finally converted.
explanation.walkthrough: The final Y of SUNNY is changed to I.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunni is the larger of the two main branches of Islam, and a follower of it.

clue.text: Hormone synthesised by Latino men

indicators.note: synthesised means made up from parts, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A hormone produced in a lab by Latin American men.
explanation.definitionFit: Melatonin is the hormone regulating sleep cycles.

clue.text: As pickpocket maybe faint, being identified to police

parts.note: light means faint, as of a touch or colour
fingered is slang for informed on to the police

explanation.surface: A pickpocket goes faint on being named to the police.
explanation.definitionFit: Light-fingered describes a thief skilled at stealing unnoticed.

clue.text: Wicked deeds by Zulu warriors over European links

indicators.note: in a down clue, over puts the warriors above the rest

parts.note: an impi is a Zulu regiment of warriors
ties are links or bonds

explanation.surface: Atrocities by Zulu fighters over ties with Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Impieties are acts of irreverence or ungodliness.

clue.text: Edition of Stalingrad?

definitions.meaning: first sense: the editing of a text, or the version so produced
second sense, split in two: Soviet (Red) fighting, as in that famous battle

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as RED ACTION: the Red Army's battle at Stalingrad. Edition is the definition of the whole word.
explanation.definitionFit: Redaction means editing a text for publication, or a version so produced.

clue.text: Escort stranger routed round part of New England

indicators.note: round says the reshuffled word goes around the state
stranger means more odd, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: RI is Rhode Island, a New England state

explanation.surface: An escort, a stranger who was beaten around somewhere in New England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stranger' looks like a noun for an unknown person but is the comparative of strange, the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An outrider is a motorcyclist or rider escorting a vehicle.

clue.text: Without warning United captain is sacked

indicators.note: sacked suggests a place ransacked and thrown into disorder, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A football club's captain is dismissed with no notice.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unanticipated arrives unforeseen, without any warning.

clue.text: Husbandry only for the young?

parts.note: split the farming word in two: a preposition meaning until, then a word for a stage of life, so something lasting only up to a certain point in one's years

explanation.walkthrough: Split as TILL AGE: something only for the young lasts until an age.
explanation.definitionFit: Tillage is the cultivation of land, part of farming.

clue.text: Every single participant making finish of a marathon

definitions.meaning: first sense, read as three words
second sense: ..., the London avenue where the London Marathon ends

explanation.walkthrough: The Mall is the ceremonial road leading to Buckingham Palace in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Them all covers everyone taking part, and The Mall hosts the race's finishing line.

clue.text: Fine meat, English, served with brandy

parts.note: F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine
lamb is a meat

explanation.surface: A restaurant dish: good English meat with a brandy sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Flambé dishes are doused in spirit such as brandy and set alight.

clue.text: Returned letter I afterwards get back

indicators.note: returned means the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: eta is a Greek letter
later means afterwards

explanation.surface: A letter sent back, which I will deal with later.
explanation.walkthrough: ETA, I and LATER together read ETAILATER; backwards that gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To retaliate is to get back at someone, to take revenge.

clue.text: Do drink

definitions.meaning: first sense: do (doh) is the ..., the keynote of a scale in ... sol-fa
second sense: ... water, a mixer drink

explanation.walkthrough: 'Do' looks like a verb but is the sol-fa note.
explanation.definitionFit: In music the keynote of a scale is the tonic, and a quinine mixer is tonic water.

clue.text: Opposition party missing opening of prayer

indicators.note: missing opening means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: the praying mantis, hence a prayer

explanation.surface: An opposition group without a prayer to begin with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prayer' is not a petition but one who prays: the praying mantis.
explanation.definitionFit: Antis are those against something, collectively the opposing side.

clue.text: Very good to forget Lent? Do better!

indicators.note: to forget means the named letters are left out

parts.note: excellent means very good
taken as the letters of Lent

explanation.surface: A churchgoer's exhortation: ignore Lent and improve yourself.
explanation.definitionFit: To excel is to surpass, outperforming others.

clue.text: Woman partial to Chardonnay

indicators.note: partial means only part of the wine word is used

explanation.surface: A woman who likes Chardonnay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partial to' reads as fondness but means a part of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Donna is the Italian title for a lady.

clue.text: Holiday island's restrained by well-ordered social solidarity

indicators.note: restrained by means held inside the tidy word

parts.note: trim means neat, well-ordered
Bali is a holiday island, plus the S of the possessive

explanation.surface: A resort island kept in check by a tidy sense of community.
explanation.definitionFit: Tribalism is strong loyalty to one's own group.

clue.text: Bats set out on shelf

indicators.note: in an across clue, on places the jumbled letters after the shelf

parts.note: a rack is a shelf or stand

indicators.note: out means the letters of set are disordered

explanation.surface: Bats laid out on a shelf.
explanation.walkthrough: These are bats for squash-like games, not flying animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Rackets are the strung bats used in tennis and squash.

clue.text: Often a requirement of the court for Hamlet's rest

definitions.text: Often a requirement of the court
definitions.meaning: first sense: quiet, demanded in a courtroom
second sense: Hamlet's dying words are 'the rest is ...'

explanation.walkthrough: Hamlet dies saying 'The rest is silence'.
explanation.definitionFit: Courts call for quiet, and Shakespeare's prince equates the hereafter with quietness.
